in_arabic.name: Malmal
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني The Protected One
in_arabic.long_meaning: Malmal هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root ‘mlm’, which means ‘to protect’ or ‘to be protected’. In Islamic context, Malmal signifies the one who is protected by Allah and cherished in the divine presence.
